_notes: Manual threshold overrides, committed WITH the PR (not in the orphan-branch window).
This is the escape hatch from ci-regression-gate-config-info.md: when a PR legitimately
changes performance, or a task is temporarily flaky, the author adjusts the gate here in the
same commit, so the change is reviewed alongside the code.
k_warn / k_block      -- sigma multipliers on the MAD spread (PASS/WARN/BLOCK bands).
min_spread_pct        -- floor on spread as % of center (guards tiny windows).
pin_center_fps        -- pin the baseline center (e.g. an intended perf change).
tail_p99_warn         -- opt-in: WARN (never BLOCK) when post-warm-up p99/median step ratio
exceeds this. Surfaces tail/spike regressions the FPS mean hides.
Leave unset for tasks with real recurring spikes (e.g. g1-flat).
skip (true)           -- force PASS for a task (quarantine); use sparingly.
